mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates a failure to control inflation, triggering market concerns about stagflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle with a tight labor market (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% and unemployment below 4.0%), the market anticipates reduced corporate profits from higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 30% of instances when FEDFUNDS rising and > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1.2 million units indicates a contraction in the residential sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1.2.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average AND INDPRO < 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 35% of instances when RSAFS and INDPRO are both below 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls below 50,000 persons indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 50.0.
